title: Transfer Mileage Allowance for Commercial Fleet Accounts — Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit
content:
The transfer mileage allowance adds miles to the re-based expiration odometer of a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans moved onto a replacement unit. It reads the tier of the customer's service account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Service account tier | Transfer mileage allowance |
|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 1000 miles |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 500 miles |
| Any other account | No transfer mileage allowance |

The allowance depends on the tier alone. It is not reduced by the account's balance or its payment history.
